                               鑒的經驗與標杆。四環醫藥榮登榜單第一梯隊，一定程度上意味著在創新藥領域的綜合實力和競
                               爭優勢已獲市場認可，具有可持續發展的潛力和良好的投資前景。


                               “2023 Top 100 Chinese Pharmaceutical Innovative
                               Enterprises”
                               The “2023 Top 100 Chinese Pharmaceutical Innovative Enterprises” list selected by Healthcare
                               Executives has been released. Based on the “three dimensions and four indicators” selection system,
                               the “Top 100 Chinese Pharmaceutical Innovative Enterprises” are selected every year as the first camp
                               to represent China’s pharmaceutical innovation capabilities. They are a major force in the transformation
                               and upgrading of China’s pharmaceutical industry and the building of its competitiveness. They also
                               provide experience and benchmarks for the future generations to learn from. The fact that Sihuan
                               Pharmaceutical has been ranked in the first echelon of the list represents to a certain extent
                               that its comprehensive strength and competitive advantages in the innovative drug field have been
                               recognized by the market, and that it has potential for sustainable development and good investment
                               prospects.




                             「2023 年度轉型先鋒企業」
                               12 月 20 日至 22 日，第八屆「格隆匯 • 全球投資嘉年華 • 2024」於深圳盛大開幕。格隆匯「金格獎」
                               年度卓越公司評選中，四環醫藥就憑藉創新求變的經營策略，以及該策略下全新塑造的醫美與創
                               新藥雙輪驅動，榮獲「2023 年度轉型先鋒企業」獎項。


                              「年度轉型先鋒企業」獎著重關注企業對動態環境變化的適應力，以及實現長期可持續、高質量發
                               展的能力，真正通過轉型創造價值、保持創新活力，並對產業升級產生積極影響的領先企業。該
                               獎項體現對擁有卓越的財務表現、善於創新、充滿韌性，社會效益和經濟效益並重公司的肯定。
                               本次評選通過定量數據分析和專家評審團等方式得出最終結果。


                               “Transformation Pioneer Enterprise of the Year 2023”
                               The 8th “Gelonghui • Global Investment Carnival • 2024” was held in Shenzhen from 20 to 22
                               December. In the annual outstanding company selection of Gelonghui’s “Jinge Award”, Sihuan
                               Pharmaceutical won the “Transformation Pioneer Enterprise of the Year 2023” by virtue of
                               its innovative and transformative business strategy and its newly shaped two-wheel drive of
                               medical aesthetics and innovative drugs.


                               The “Transformation Pioneer Enterprise of the Year” award focuses on the enterprise’s adaptability
                               to dynamic environmental changes and its ability to achieve long-term sustainable and high-quality
                               development; the winner is also a leading enterprise that have truly created value and maintained

二零二二年股份獎勵計劃的目的                 Purpose of the 2022 Share Award Scheme
二零二二年股份獎勵計劃為一項股份激勵計劃，          The 2022 Share Award Scheme is a share incentive scheme and is established to
乃為認可及表彰承授人對本集團所作出或可能           recognize and acknowledge the contributions which the grantees have made or may
作出的貢獻而設立。二零二二年股份獎勵計劃           make to the Group. The 2022 Share Award Scheme will provide the grantees with
將向承授人提供個人持有本公司股權的機會，           the opportunity to own a personal stake in the Company with a view to achieving the
以達至以下目標：(i) 激勵承授人；及╱或 (ii) 吸   following objectives: (i) motivating the grantees; and/or (ii) attracting and retaining or
引及挽留所作貢獻有利、將有利或可能有利於           otherwise maintaining on-going relationship with the grantees whose contributions are,
本集團長期發展的承授人，或以其他方式與彼           will be or are likely to be beneficial to the long-term growth of the Group.
等維持持續關係。

 2.   重 大 會 計 政策（續）                          2.   MATERIAL ACCOUNTING POLICIES (continued)
      2.1 編製基準（續）                                 2.1 Basis of preparation (continued)
            合併基準                                       Basis of consolidation
            本綜合財務報表包括本公司及其                             The consolidated financial statements include the financial statements of
            附 屬 公 司（統 稱「本 集 團」
                             ）截 至 二                    the Company and its subsidiaries (collectively referred to as the “Group”)
            零二三年十二月三十一日止年度                             for the year ended 31 December 2023. A subsidiary is an entity (including a
            之財務報表。附屬公司指本公司直                            structured entity), directly or indirectly, controlled by the Company. Control
            接或間接控制之實體（包括結構性                            is achieved when the Group is exposed, or has rights, to variable returns
            實體）。當本集團能透過其參與承                            from its involvement with the investee and has the ability to affect those
            擔或享有投資對象可變回報之風                             returns through its power over the investee (i.e., existing rights that give
            險或權利，並能夠向投資對象使用                            the Group the current ability to direct the relevant activities of the investee).
            其權力影響回報金額（即現有權利
            可使本集團能於當時指示投資對
            象之相關活動），即代表本集團擁
            有控制權。

            本集團管理資本的主要目標為保                                   The primary objectives of the Group’s capital management are to
            障本集團的持續營運能力，以及維                                  safeguard the Group’s ability to continue as a going concern and to
            持穩健的資金比率，以支持其業務                                  maintain healthy capital ratios in order to support its business and maximise
            及將股東價值最大化。                                       shareholders’ value.


            本集團管理其資本架構，並應經濟                                  The Group manages its capital structure and makes adjustments to it in
            狀況之變化對其作出調整。為維持                                  light of changes in economic conditions. To maintain or adjust the capital
            或調整資本架構，本集團可能調整                                  structure, the Group may adjust the dividend payments to shareholders,
            向股東派付之股息款項、向股東退                                  return capital to shareholders or issue new shares. The Group is not subject
            回資本或發行新股。本集團毋須遵                                  to any externally imposed capital requirements. No changes were made in
            守任何外部施加的資本規定。截至                                  the objectives, policies or processes for managing capital during the years
            二零二三年十二月三十一日及二                                   ended 31 December 2023 and 31 December 2022.
            零二二年十二月三十一日止年度，
            概無對管理資本之目標、政策或程
            序作出任何變更。
